description:
Seamless multi-border screen switching for Logitech Easy-Switch keyboards and mice across Windows & Linux

Lunifier coordinates Logitech Easy-Switch keyboards (MX Keys, etc.) and mice
(MX Master series, M720 Triathlon, POP, etc.) across screens without requiring
a shared local Wi-Fi or cloud connection. Features instant hardware switching,
configurable border dwell zones, double-touch knock trigger, system tray controls,
global keyboard shortcuts, and Bluetooth inter-host cursor alignment.
